title: Konkan Naval: BCU-24 CAN telemetry drops after cold start
description: Konkan Naval Electronics reports that 6 BCU-24 Rev A battery chargers stop reporting CAN telemetry to their power management system after a cold start, and only recover after a power cycle. They are evaluating whether to accept the 60 units on SO-884.

comments.author: Nagarjun
comments.body: Logs show the CT-1051 CAN transceiver entering bus-off during the cold-start inrush. The firmware never requests bus-off recovery, so telemetry stays down.

comments.author: Sai
comments.body: We can add automatic bus-off recovery with a watchdog that re-initialises the CT-1051 after 3 missed heartbeats. Can ship in Firmware 2.4 if it is prioritised.
